title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Deductible Amounts Across the Tiers
content:
Three deductible figures are set for every tier of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims`. Each is an amount in US dollars applied per claim.

## The three figures

- **General deductible.** The deductible that stands against any claim under the tier.
- **Wet damage deductible.** The deductible that stands against a claim for goods damaged by water or moisture.
- **Temperature damage deductible.** The deductible that stands against a claim for goods damaged by the carrying temperature.

## Comparison table (USD per claim)

| Tier | General deductible | Wet damage deductible | Temperature damage deductible |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 0.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 250.00 | 500.00 | 750.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 100.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Notes on the table

- The two tiers at the foot of the ladder and the top tier, `AHL CargoCare Total`, set all three figures at zero.
- Under `AHL CargoCare Essential` the temperature damage figure is zero; the wet damage figure there, 1000.00, is twice the general figure of 500.00.
- Under `AHL CargoCare Plus` the temperature damage figure of 750.00 is the largest of that tier's three amounts.
